scope: Two uniquely owned free parameter groups and two users. No cache/database cluster, subnet, standing resource or account default mutation.

Parameters.Name: acllog-max-len
Parameters.Description: The maximum length of the ACL Log

Parameters.Name: activedefrag
Parameters.Description: Enabled active memory defragmentation

Parameters.Name: active-defrag-cycle-max
Parameters.Description: Maximal effort for defrag in CPU percentage

Parameters.Name: active-defrag-cycle-min
Parameters.Description: Minimal effort for defrag in CPU percentage

Parameters.Name: active-defrag-ignore-bytes
Parameters.Description: Minimum amount of fragmentation waste to start active defrag

Parameters.Name: active-defrag-max-scan-fields
Parameters.Description: Maximum number of set/hash/zset/list fields that will be processed from the main dictionary scan

Parameters.Name: active-defrag-threshold-lower
Parameters.Description: Minimum percentage of fragmentation to start active defrag

Parameters.Name: active-defrag-threshold-upper
Parameters.Description: Maximum percentage of fragmentation at which we use maximum effort

Parameters.Name: active-expire-effort
Parameters.Description: The amount of effort that redis uses to expire items in the active expiration job

Parameters.Name: client-output-buffer-limit-normal-hard-limit
Parameters.Description: Normal client output buffer hard limit in bytes

Parameters.Name: client-output-buffer-limit-normal-soft-limit
Parameters.Description: Normal client output buffer soft limit in bytes

Parameters.Name: client-output-buffer-limit-normal-soft-seconds
Parameters.Description: Normal client output buffer soft limit in seconds

Parameters.Name: client-output-buffer-limit-pubsub-hard-limit
Parameters.Description: Pubsub client output buffer hard limit in bytes

Parameters.Name: client-output-buffer-limit-pubsub-soft-limit
Parameters.Description: Pubsub client output buffer soft limit in bytes

Parameters.Name: client-output-buffer-limit-pubsub-soft-seconds
Parameters.Description: Pubsub client output buffer soft limit in seconds

Parameters.Name: hash-max-listpack-entries
Parameters.Description: The maximum number of hash entries in order for the dataset to be compressed

Parameters.Name: hash-max-listpack-value
Parameters.Description: The threshold of biggest hash entries in order for the dataset to be compressed

Parameters.Name: hll-sparse-max-bytes
Parameters.Description: HyperLogLog sparse representation bytes limit

Parameters.Name: latency-tracking
Parameters.Description: Track the per command latencies and enable exporting the percentile distribution via the INFO latencystats command and cumulative latency distributions (histograms) via the LATENCY command.

Parameters.Name: lazyfree-lazy-eviction
Parameters.Description: Perform an asynchronous delete on evictions

Parameters.Name: lazyfree-lazy-expire
Parameters.Description: Perform an asynchronous delete on expired keys

Parameters.Name: lazyfree-lazy-server-del
Parameters.Description: Perform an asynchronous delete on key updates

Parameters.Name: lazyfree-lazy-user-del
Parameters.Description: Specifies whether the default behavior of DEL command acts the same as UNLINK

Parameters.Name: lfu-decay-time
Parameters.Description: The amount of time in minutes to decrement the key counter for LFU eviction policyd

Parameters.Name: lfu-log-factor
Parameters.Description: The log factor for incrementing key counter for LFU eviction policy

Parameters.Name: list-compress-depth
Parameters.Description: Number of quicklist ziplist nodes from each side of the list to exclude from compression. The head and tail of the list are always uncompressed for fast push/pop operations

Parameters.Name: maxmemory-policy
Parameters.Description: Max memory policy

Parameters.Name: maxmemory-samples
Parameters.Description: Max memory samples

Parameters.Name: notify-keyspace-events
Parameters.Description: The keyspace events for Redis to notify Pub/Sub clients about. By default all notifications are disabled

Parameters.Name: search-enabled
Parameters.Description: When set to yes, it enables search capabilities.

Parameters.Name: search-query-timeout-ms
Parameters.Description: The maximum amount of time in milliseconds that a search query is allowed to run.

Parameters.Name: set-max-intset-entries
Parameters.Description: The limit in the size of the set in order for the dataset to be compressed

Parameters.Name: slowlog-log-slower-than
Parameters.Description: The execution time, in microseconds, to exceed in order for the command to get logged. Note that a negative number disables the slow log, while a value of zero forces the logging of every command

Parameters.Name: slowlog-max-len
Parameters.Description: The length of the slow log. There is no limit to this length. Just be aware that it will consume memory. You can reclaim memory used by the slow log with SLOWLOG RESET.

Parameters.Name: stream-node-max-bytes
Parameters.Description: The maximum size of a single node in a stream in bytes

Parameters.Name: stream-node-max-entries
Parameters.Description: The maximum number of items a single node in a stream can contain

Parameters.Name: tcp-keepalive
Parameters.Description: If non-zero, send ACKs every given number of seconds

Parameters.Name: timeout
Parameters.Description: Close connection if client is idle for a given number of seconds, or never if 0

Parameters.Name: tracking-table-max-keys
Parameters.Description: The maximum number of keys allowed for the tracking table for client side caching

Parameters.Name: zset-max-listpack-entries
Parameters.Description: The maximum number of sorted set entries in order for the dataset to be compressed

Parameters.Name: zset-max-listpack-value
Parameters.Description: The threshold of biggest sorted set entries in order for the dataset to be compressed
